priorityList: Ensure Battle Stance is active at all times.
Use Avatar on cooldown to maximize damage and rage generation.
Maintain Shield Block uptime, refreshing it if less than 10 seconds remain.
Cast Ignore Pain to avoid rage capping, especially before using Shield Slam, Shield Charge, or Demoralizing Shout.
Cast Demolish once you have reached at least 3 stacks of Colossal Might.
Cast Demoralizing Shout on cooldown if Booming Voice is talented for the damage and rage bonus.
Cast Champion's Spear and Shield Charge on cooldown.
Cast Shield Slam as your highest priority rotational ability.
Cast Thunder Clap as your secondary priority rotational ability.
Cast Execute if Sudden Death procs or if the target is in execute range and you have at least 40 Rage.
Cast Revenge if Ravager is active or if you have a free 'Revenge!' proc.
Cast Revenge to spend excess rage if you are above 80 Rage and Shield Slam is on cooldown.
Cast Wrecking Throw or Shattering Throw if Javelineer is talented and other abilities are on cooldown.
Use Devastate as a filler if no other abilities are available.
